summary: FedEx Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its spin-off of FedEx Freight Holding Company into a new publicly traded company. FedEx distributed 80.1% of FedEx Freight's common stock to its stockholders. The transaction was governed by a Separation and Distribution Agreement executed May 28, 2026, alongside ancillary agreements to manage the ongoing relationship. No price per share or premium is applicable as this is a pro-rata distribution. The board recommended the spin-off; no advisor is named. Watch for the start of FedEx Freight's public trading and any subsequent sales of FedEx's retained stake.
